summary.text: Michela Hites is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia's campaign-finance listing records that Michela Hites lost general-election races for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 16 in 2022 and 2024.
